cards.title: Practice, honestly
cards.text: 586 laps run and nothing at stake. What it does tell you is who looks comfortable and who is fighting the car.

cards.title: Norris: 1:15.426
cards.text: In a McLaren. Take practice times with salt: fuel loads are secret and nobody shows their hand.

cards.title: Perez racked up 33 laps
cards.text: Track time is the currency of a Friday. Whoever runs most learns most, and burns the most rubber doing it.

cards.title: What they ran, and on what
cards.text: Compound choice on a Friday is a rehearsal for Sunday's plan.

cards.title: Piastri topped the trap at 353 km/h
cards.text: Early wing choices show up here before anybody admits to them.

cards.title: 12 flag calls
cards.text: Every interruption costs somebody a run they had planned.

cards.title: Track between 44°C and 50°C
cards.text: Friday conditions rarely match Sunday, which is why the times you see here mislead so often.
